facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit - kinetic exposure at HT-9005

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9005 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9005 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9005 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 11 March 2005 a near hit was recorded on HT-9005 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
